Who we are

Community-led action for a stronger Rohingya community.

Refugee Wellness Mission (RWM) is a Rohingya refugee-led, youth-driven, volunteer-based community initiative in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh. We bring young people and community volunteers together to promote health awareness, wellbeing, youth leadership, education, protection awareness and community development.

We believe community members are not only participants in change; they are essential leaders in shaping it.

Support community-led action

Your support can help strengthen community initiatives.

We welcome conversations with individuals and organisations interested in supporting RWM's community-led activities, including awareness sessions, youth learning and hygiene promotion.

Please contact RWM before sending money. We will share verified contribution arrangements and explain the purpose and process. Do not send funds to personal accounts claiming to represent RWM unless independently verified with the RWM team.
